pitfalls: Two export-time adjustments for current litert-torch: (1) LongRoPE — replace Phi3RotaryEmbedding.forward with a static version (the @dynamic_rope_update seq-len branch is data-dependent under torch.export; for cache <= original_max=4096 the short factor is always correct); (2) sliding window — set config.sliding_window=None (it is 262144 >> context, i.e. full-causal) so the standard causal mask path is used (HF card Conversion).
